product_one_liner.value: Mimica helps large enterprises capture employees’ desktop activity, map business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and automate workflows with AI agents.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes capturing clicks and keystrokes, generating process maps, and deploying agents, and explicitly identifies large enterprises as its strongest fit. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or plans were found in the homepage navigation or footer; the sales route is a demo/contact form, and the pricing endpoint did not yield a usable pricing page. Sources: https://www.mimica.ai/ and https://www.mimica.ai/contact.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage presents customer testimonials from Goodyear’s Deanna Pratt and ClearBank’s Doug Thomson, each describing actual use of Mimica. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/. | named_customers.0: Goodyear’s named representative describes using Mimica in a homepage testimonial: https://www.mimica.ai/. | named_customers.1: ClearBank’s named representative describes using Mimica in a homepage testimonial: https://www.mimica.ai/.

employee_band.notes: Mimica’s company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees. A September 2026 directory estimate of approximately 293 falls within the same band. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/mimicaautomation and https://leadiq.com/c/mimica/5ba27d6f230000a53afe52ad/employee-directory.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly identifies London as headquarters, consistent with the official London address. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/mimicaautomation and https://www.mimica.ai/about-us. | hq_country: The company profile identifies headquarters as London, England, normalized here to the country United Kingdom; the official website also gives a London address. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/mimicaautomation and https://www.mimica.ai/about-us.

founded_year.notes: Mimica’s company profile explicitly lists 2018 as its founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/mimicaautomation.

eng_blog.notes: The readable article index contains product announcements, educational marketing, company news, and business-use-case posts, rather than at least two engineer-authored accounts of how Mimica is built. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/articles.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer provide no public documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link. Searches did not identify a qualifying portal, and the docs/help subdomain checks returned no readable documentation. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer posting includes an application link. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Mimica/157112c3-9fbf-440b-a5e4-5c40f0cd2fa0.

model_provider.notes: Mimica’s Forward Deployed Engineer posting explicitly names Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), and GPT (OpenAI) for its agentic AI solutions. This supports the named models, but does not establish exclusive providers or specific production versions. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/mimica/c69566a5-bcdf-4380-b40e-a7844acecfd8.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The homepage explicitly claims ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance (https://www.mimica.ai/), and the trust center lists ISO 27001:2022 (https://trust.mimica.ai/overview). These are reported as public claims, not independent certification verification. | compliance_certs.0: The trust center explicitly lists ISO 27001:2022: https://trust.mimica.ai/overview. | compliance_certs.1: The homepage explicitly claims GDPR compliance: https://www.mimica.ai/.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Mimica explicitly identifies the $26.2 million financing as Series B, the latest disclosed capital round found. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-secures-26-2-million-in-series-b-funding-to-train-agentic-ai-on-real-enterprise-workflows. | funding_date: The Series B announcement is dated September 24, 2025, giving 2025-09. A later January 2026 accelerator/incubator listing does not disclose a capital raise and was not treated as evidence of a newer funding round. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-secures-26-2-million-in-series-b-funding-to-train-agentic-ai-on-real-enterprise-workflows. | funding_amount_usd: The company announcement reports a $26.2 million Series B, equivalent to USD 26,200,000. This is the latest disclosed capital round found. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-secures-26-2-million-in-series-b-funding-to-train-agentic-ai-on-real-enterprise-workflows.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 24, 2025 Series B falls within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-secures-26-2-million-in-series-b-funding-to-train-agentic-ai-on-real-enterprise-workflows.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Associate Business Development Representative posting has an application link and is a qualifying BDR role. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/mimica/b64e2711-b743-4d59-8115-15c46fda5095.

launched_6mo.notes: Mimica introduced Maker on September 30, 2026, within six months of November 9, 2026. The announcement describes a substantive agentic automation platform, not a minor interface update. Source: https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-maker-ai-agents-watch-learn.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Julio Acosta-Cabronero’s profile lists a September 2026 start at Mimica as VP of ML/AI, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/julio-ac.
